questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.S1) His wristwatch had gone out of order. P) He took it to a watch repairer.Q) He gave an idea of the likely cost of the replacement based on the examination of the watch.R) He found that some parts needed replacement.S) The repairer opened the outer case and checked the parts.S6) His estimate appeared reasonable.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.The gardener of the house has been waiting for _____ hour to take his money.
Select the most appropriate verb to fill in the blank.It  __________ since early morning.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (has been raining) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage and answer the given questions.Since the world has become industrialised, the number of animal species that have either become extinct or are nearing extinction has increased. The Bengal tiger, for instance, which once roamed the jungle in vast numbers, now has a population of only 2,300. By the year 2025, this number is projected to drop to zero. What is particularly alarming about the case of the Bengal tiger is that its extinction will have been caused almost entirely by poachers who, according to some sources, are motivated not by material gain but by personal gratification. This reflects a disturbing level of callousness that contributes significantly to the problem of extinction. Animals like the Bengal tiger, along with other endangered species, are vital components of the world’s ecosystem. International laws protecting these animals must be enacted and enforced to ensure their survival and, ultimately, the survival of our planet.Countries around the world have begun to address the problem in various ways. Some nations, in an effort to circumvent the issue, have allocated large areas of land for animal reserves. They charge admission to help defray the costs of maintaining these parks and often rely on support from international organisations as well. With the funds they receive, they can invest in equipment and patrols to protect the animals. Another solution aimed at stemming the tide of animal extinction is an international boycott of products made from endangered species. This measure appears to be fairly effective, but it will not, on its own, prevent animals from being hunted and killed. What is the central theme of the passage?
options: The importance of preserving endangered species for ecological balance
The economic benefits of wildlife tourism
The historical habitats of extinct animals
The popularity of Bengal tigers among poachers
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The importance of preserving endangered species for ecological balance) है।
